In this video, we’ll learn everything about Delta Lake, the most powerful storage layer for modern data engineering. You’ll understand why Delta Lake is the core of data analytics in Databricks and PySpark — from its ACID transactions to schema evolution, time travel, and merge operations.
What you’ll learn:
What is Delta Lake and how it differs from a traditional Data Lake
How Delta Lake adds ACID Transactions to Parquet files
Understanding Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability (ACID)
Delta Table Structure – Parquet files + Transaction Logs
